verdict.rationale: Phaser's own documentation and community evidence describe it exclusively as a 2D HTML5/WebGL game framework (sprites, tilemaps, 2D physics, 2D animations, 2D filters like Glow/Shadow/Blur in the editor) with no mention of PBR materials, global illumination, baked lighting, 3D shadow mapping, or a 3D rendering pipeline anywhere in the evidence pack.
